title: 第13章 放一杀十第14章 血的教训

第十三章 放一杀十
郭飞的话提醒了众人，金大通一怔，随即意识到了这个问题，他在这里征战近三年，焉能不知骷髅兵的战力。只是喜上眉梢，头脑发热一时兴奋遮蔽了双眼。
顿时摸着脑袋憨笑一声道：“老十提醒的对，这骷髅兵也不是软蛋，如果他们拼死一战，还真危险。”
黝黑的洞口深不见底，黑乎乎的没有一丝光芒，纵然是郭飞也只能看出几米远，凭感觉，郭飞知道里面潜藏了不少骷髅。
“老大，我这里有个一级‘火球符’，或许有用！”老二犹犹豫豫的出声道。
“老二，你怎么磨磨唧唧的，有这样的好东西赶快拿出来。”金大通一听，顿时急声道。
“呵呵。老大，这可是我花费二十个魂晶换的，本来想关键时候保命用的，获得魂晶后可要补偿我呀！”老二闪着小眼，盯着金大通道。
几人一听，顿时心中有点不是滋味，但都知道，这火球符确实珍贵，尤其是对付骷髅兵，效果显著。
“老二，你这‘小家子气’什么时候能改改。兄弟们和我心中都有杆秤，你付出的多，难道我们还亏了你不成。弟兄们在一起，讲究的是缘分，是感情！”金大通大脸一虎，沉声道。
老二头一低，从夹层的衣袋中摸出一个布袋子，小心的从布带中掏出一块形似兽皮的东西。
郭飞没有见过“火球符”，凑过去看，十人中，大部分没有见过，也都凑过去看。金大通虎视眈眈的守在洞口。
这是一块兽皮，兽皮上面用血液刻画着奇怪的符文，凑在近处，有一股热流扑面而来，似乎里面含着魔力。
老二颇为惋惜的走到洞口，闭目将兽皮揉成一团，瞬间抛了出去，兽皮发出一声呼啸冲入了洞口中。
“爆！”老二低喝一声，兽皮发出一道红光，爆出了一个篮球大小的火球，火球翻滚着朝洞内冲去，将洞里面照的锃亮。与此同时，几只守在洞口的骷髅兵仓皇后退，金大通一跃，低头钻入了洞中，随后大家都跟着冲了进去。
郭飞迅速的将玄铁剑取出，将弯刀虚影退出身体，将剑影入体，顿时一股澎湃的热流窜入身体，顿时力量大增。手中玄铁剑发出厉声呼啸，朝旁边的骷髅兵杀去。
洞中空间极大，藏了不少骷髅兵，十人组成攻防队形，立即展开了厮杀，将洞口的骷髅兵杀死，在洞口立住了脚。
这些骷髅兵似乎没有抵抗之心，杀死四五个后，其余的迅速的后退，聚集到了山洞后方石壁处，老二燃起火捻一照，竟然有二三百个，众人倒吸了一口冷气。
此时，他们看没有了退路，将手中骨刀齐齐的举起，眼中黯淡的红光逐渐的放出了光芒。
“老大，骷髅的精神之火又重新燃起，这是他们要拼命的前奏，这么多我们恐怕不敌呀！”老二低声道。
“你们说怎么办。煮熟的鸭子不能白白飞走了！”

“老大，我们放一杀十！”郭飞低声沉思一下，轻声道。
“什么意思？”金大通有点疑惑道。
“闪开道路，放走一部分，这些骷髅就以为有生的希望了，其余的肯定没有抵抗之心，只顾逃命，这个洞口这么小，他们挤在一起，一时出不去那么多，我们就可以在后面轻松斩杀了。”郭飞沉思道。
“呵呵。老十精明，比俺强，俺娘常讲，一口不能吃个胖子，应该就是这个道理，哈哈。闪开一边，让他们逃几个出去。”金大通一笑道。
十人变幻队形，闪过一边，离洞口近的三个骷髅迅速的窜了出去，后面的骷髅一看，一窝蜂的跟着往前冲，一下子堵在了小洞口，越想冲出去，越出去的慢。最前面的一个骷髅一下子摔倒，堵住了门。
“这些骷髅到底是怎么形成的，到底有什么智力？”看到这一幕，郭飞不禁思索道。
十人迅速的冲了上去，在后面对骷髅兵展开了厮杀。郭飞的玄铁剑如同一把黑色的闪电，在黑暗的洞中不住的砍掉骷髅的头颅。速度极快，让金大通等人看傻了眼。
郭飞动力十足，一股升级变强的动力支撑着。半个时辰，除去逃走的骷髅，郭飞等人猎杀了一百二十个骷髅，以十人战力能不受伤猎杀这么多骷髅，完全是天大的收获。
通过实战检验，郭飞感到，从文叔哪里学习来的这套剑法，当真是玄妙。就如同喝茶一样，第一口喝的是清冽甘苦，以后越品越有韵味。
刚开始，郭飞理解到这套剑法的精髓是“快”，随着厮杀，郭飞渐渐发现这套剑法留有后手。似乎剑法施展开来，远远没有达到应有的杀伤力，就如同秋风扫落叶一样，看上去是风吹叶落，其实是寒气暗藏在了风中，将树叶生机吸取，才使它随风落下。
这套剑法只有十招，至于其发展空间，郭飞只是冥冥中感到，但一时摸不着门道，似乎体内那股热流才是发展的关键。只是没有人指点，却是摸不透。
郭飞下定决心，下次见到文叔一定要问一问。解开自己心中的疑惑。
“文叔绝非普通人，当天他被俘虏，小小骷髅兵自然伤不了他。究竟他为什么隐姓埋名去当奴兵呢？”郭飞心中始终想不通。
“哈哈，二百四十块魂晶，大收获呀、大收获！哈哈。老十当记首功，老九收好了。”金大通哈哈大笑，打断了郭飞的思路。
“哼！”老二不由自主的冷哼一声，似乎有点不舒服。
“哈哈。当然了，老二耗费一枚火球符，也居功甚伟。”金大通眼睛瞄了老二一眼，轻轻一笑道。
十人清理完战利品，并没有立即离去，奔波了一天，厮杀了这么长时间，又渴又饿了，在山洞中即安全又温暖，十人坐下来
“寒气太重，兄弟们热热身，继续追袭骷髅。今天运气不错，后面肯定有大收获。”金大通拿出一袋子烈酒，每人传着喝了一口。
这个世界的酒，郭飞喝过几次，比地球上的差远了。郭飞初中以前从来不喝酒，是个乖乖的好学生；父母离异后，生活剧变，才接触了酒，虽然不上瘾，但也颇为喜欢，醉过很多次。
每当举起酒杯，就想起了家乡的明月。淡酒一口，相思一梦，郭飞怔怔的出神，到现在他时常有错觉，梦想着一睁眼就出现在师大的校园内。

“走了！”金大通整理一下装具，朝身后几人摆摆手，众人都站起身，金大通当前走去，但扭头一看，郭飞依然在仰望洞顶沉思，就走回来拉起了郭飞。

content_en:
Chapter Thirteen Let one go and kill ten
Guo Fei's words reminded everyone, Jin Datong was startled, and then realized this problem. He had been fighting here for nearly three years, how could he not know the combat power of the skeleton soldiers. He was just happy, his head was filled with excitement and his eyes were covered by excitement.
He immediately touched his head and laughed naively: "Old Ten is right to remind you, these skeleton soldiers are not weaklings. If they fight to the death, they will be really dangerous."
The dark cave entrance was bottomless, so dark that there was no light. Even Guo Fei could only see a few meters away. By feeling, Guo Fei knew that there were many skeletons hidden inside.
"Boss, I have a first-level 'Fireball Talisman' here, it might be useful!" the second child said hesitantly.
"Second brother, why are you so annoying? Take out such a good thing as soon as possible." When Jin Datong heard this, he said urgently.
"Haha. Boss, I spent twenty soul crystals to get this. I originally wanted to use it to save my life at a critical moment. You have to make it up to me after you get the soul crystals!" The second child stared at the golden passage with his small eyes flashing.
When several people heard this, they felt a little uncomfortable, but they all knew that this fireball talisman was indeed precious, and it was especially effective against skeleton soldiers.
"Second brother, when will you change your 'little family spirit'? Brothers and I have a strong balance in our hearts. You have paid a lot, so why don't we still owe you a loss? When brothers are together, what matters is fate and affection!" Jin Datong said in a deep voice with a big face.
The second brother lowered his head, took out a cloth bag from the sandwich pocket, and carefully took out a piece of animal skin-like thing from the cloth belt.
Guo Fei had never seen the "Fireball Talisman" before, so he came over to take a look. Most of the ten people had not seen it before, so they all came over to take a look. Jin Datong guarded the entrance of the cave with eager eyes.
This is a piece of animal skin, with strange runes carved in blood. When you get close, you will feel a stream of heat rushing towards your face, as if it contains magic power.
The second child walked to the cave entrance with regret, closed his eyes and crumpled the animal skin into a ball, and threw it out instantly. The animal skin roared and rushed into the hole.
"Explode!" The second child shouted, and the animal hide emitted a red light, exploding a fireball the size of a basketball. The fireball rolled and rushed into the hole, illuminating the inside of the hole. At the same time, several skeleton soldiers guarding the entrance of the cave retreated. Jin Datong jumped, lowered his head and got into the cave, and then everyone rushed in.
Guo Fei quickly took out the Black Iron Sword, withdrew the scimitar shadow from his body, and inserted the sword shadow into his body. Suddenly, a surging heat flowed into his body, and his strength suddenly increased. The Black Iron Sword in his hand roared fiercely, killing the skeleton soldier next to him.
There was a huge space in the cave, and there were many skeleton soldiers hidden there. Ten people formed an offensive and defensive formation and immediately started fighting, killing the skeleton soldiers at the entrance of the cave and taking a stand at the entrance.
These skeleton soldiers seemed to have no intention of resisting. After killing four or five, the rest quickly retreated and gathered at the stone wall behind the cave. The second one lit a fire and took a look. There were two to three hundred of them. Everyone gasped.
At this time, they saw no way out and raised the bone knives in their hands. The dim red light in their eyes gradually glowed.
"Boss, the spiritual fire of the skeletons has been rekindled. This is a prelude to their desperate efforts. With so many of them, we may not be able to defeat them!" the second child said in a low voice.
"What do you want to do? The cooked duck cannot fly away in vain!"
"Boss, let's kill ten by letting one go!" Guo Fei pondered in a low voice and said softly.
"What do you mean?" Jin Datong asked a little confused.
"Get out of the way and let some of them go. These skeletons will think they have hope of survival. The rest must have no intention of resisting and just want to escape. The hole is so small and they are crowded together. They can't get out so much at the moment. We can kill them easily from behind." Guo Fei thought deeply.
"Haha. Lao Shi is smarter and better than me. My mother often said that you can't eat a fat person in one bite. This should be the truth, haha.Get out of the way and let a few of them escape. "Jin Datong said with a smile.
The ten people changed their formation and ducked aside. The three skeletons close to the cave entrance quickly rushed out. The skeletons behind them looked at them and rushed forward in a swarm, blocking the entrance of the small cave. The more they tried to rush out, the slower they got out. The skeleton at the front fell down and blocked the door.
“How are these skeletons formed, and what intelligence do they have? "Seeing this scene, Guo Fei couldn't help but think.
Ten people rushed forward quickly and started fighting against the skeleton soldiers from behind. Guo Fei's black iron sword was like a black lightning, cutting off the heads of skeletons in the dark cave. The speed was extremely fast, making Jin Datong and others dumbfounded.
Guo Fei is full of motivation, supported by the motivation to upgrade and become stronger. In half an hour, excluding the skeletons that escaped, Guo Fei and others had hunted one hundred and twenty skeletons. It was a huge harvest to be able to hunt so many skeletons without being injured with the strength of ten people.
After the actual combat test, Guo Fei felt that the swordsmanship he learned from Uncle Wen was really mysterious. Just like drinking tea, the first sip is refreshing, sweet and bitter, and the more you taste it, the more flavorful it becomes.
At first, Guo Fei understood that the essence of this sword technique was "quickness". As they fought, Guo Fei gradually discovered that this sword technique had a back-up. It seems that the sword technique is far from being as lethal as it should be, just like the autumn wind sweeping away fallen leaves. It seems that the wind blows the leaves, but in fact it is the cold air hidden in the wind that absorbs the life of the leaves, causing them to fall with the wind.
This set of swordsmanship only has ten moves. As for its development space, Guo Fei only vaguely felt it, but he couldn't figure it out for the moment. It seemed that the heat in his body was the key to development. It’s just that I can’t figure it out without anyone’s guidance.
Guo Fei made up his mind to ask Uncle Wen next time he saw him. Solve the doubts in your mind.
"Uncle Wen is no ordinary person. He was captured that day, so the little skeleton soldiers couldn't hurt him. Why on earth did he work as a slave soldier incognito? "Guo Fei still couldn't figure it out.
"Haha, two hundred and forty soul crystals, a big harvest, a big harvest! Ha ha. Lao Ten should be credited with the first merit, Lao Jiu has put it away. "Jin Datong laughed, interrupting Guo Fei's train of thought.
"Hmph! "The second child snorted involuntarily, seeming a little uncomfortable.
"Haha. Of course, the second child also made a great contribution by spending a fireball talisman. "Jin Datong glanced at Lao Er and smiled softly.
After the ten people cleaned up the loot, they did not leave immediately. After running around for a day and fighting for such a long time, they were thirsty and hungry. They were safe and warm in the cave, so they sat down.
“The cold is too strong, brothers warm up and continue to chase the skeletons. I'm lucky today, and I'm sure there will be big gains later. "Jin Datong took out a bag of spirits and everyone passed it around and took a sip.
Guo Fei has drunk the wine in this world several times, and it is far worse than the wine on earth. Guo Fei never drank before junior high school and was a good and obedient student. After his parents divorced and his life changed drastically, he came into contact with alcohol. Although he was not addicted, he liked it quite a lot and got drunk many times.
Every time I raise my glass, I think of the bright moon in my hometown. After a sip of light wine and a dream of lovesickness, Guo Fei was in a daze. To this day, he often has delusions and dreams of appearing on the campus of the Normal University as soon as he opens his eyes.
"Let's go! "Jin Datong tidied up his equipment, waved to the people behind him, and everyone stood up. Jin Datong walked away, but when he turned around, he saw that Guo Fei was still looking up at the top of the cave in deep thought, so he walked back and pulled Guo Fei up.
